neha: Heads-up — onboarding ZenFin's customer adapter into the serving catalog. I merged the adapter locally and ran a quick int8->int4 quant sweep. Seeing tokenization shifts on financial symbols ($, %, CUSIP) that affect a few sensitive prompts.
liam: Can you paste an example prompt that regresses?
neha: Example prompt that regressed: "Validate the account number: CUSIP 12345678. Return formatting and checksums." After merge, model returns malformed numbers more often.
eva: Quick results from the smoke run: accuracy (sensitive set) int8=0.92, int4=0.895; hallucination_rate int8=6%, int4=9%. Latency improved p50 int8=130ms -> int4=90ms. Full quickpack attached in /tmp/zenfin_quickpack_2024-06-...
neha: Commands used: ```
# run the quick eval pack
python ./tools/eval_pack.py --model zenfin/adapter-merge --quant int4 --batch 16 --prompts eval/zenfin_sensitive.json --out /tmp/zenfin_quickpack
```
liam: Repro here. Tokenizer mapping looks off: 'CUSIP' tokenized differently (upper vs lower case). Could be due to small vocab differences introduced by adapter token additions. Two quick options: add the token to tokenizer (tokenizer.add_tokens(['CUSIP'])) or normalize case in preprocess.
sam: Also noticed adapter config has layernorm epsilon represented inconsistently (1e-05 vs 0.00001) — probably not the root cause but worth normalizing. Pushed a tiny branch zenfin/fix-tokenizer-meta with the epsilon and config unify: https://github.com/redwood-inference/zenfin/compare/fix-tokenizer-meta
eva: Ran tokenizer-diff: 12 tokens mismatch, mostly punctuation and 'CUSIP' variants. I can generate a token remap and rerun. ETA ~45m.
eha: Plan of attack: (1) generate token remap + rebuild merged weights, (2) quantize with int4 but keep 16-bit KV cache warmstart flag, (3) rerun quickpack and run prompt sensitivity scan, (4) if regression persists, add int8 fallback route for 'zenfin-sensitive' in routing policy.
liam: Also suggest trying float16 fallback for those prompts and enable per-route regression threshold in Redwood Optimize so we get alerts at +5% hallucination.
eha: @eva please run the prompt-sensitivity scan after the remap. @sam please confirm the merge blamer output for any param mismatches (shapes/names). :eyes:
eha: small note — when rebuilding LoRA merge, include --preserve-special-tokens to avoid losing added tokens during merge.
eva: ack, running remap+merge now. I'll post a concise diff and new eval when done.
eha: eval-bot, if you can kick the smoke suite after eva's run, that'd be great.
eval-bot: eval-bot: scheduled smoke eval on the new artifacts. I will post summary to /tmp/zenfin_eval/summary.json when complete.
neha: Cool — thanks everyone. I'll hold the canary rollout until we confirm token alignment and sensitive-prompt pass. :thumbsup:
